title: When the Trail Turns
author: Tamsin Thackeray
blurb: Sable Villalobos, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
